blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Transportation (DOTr) announced that it will continue offering free rides in parts of Metro Manila on Wednesday amid a transport strike. This is after transport group Manibela earlier said that it will extend its protest and strike in Metro Manila until Nov. 25. READ: Manibela extending protest, strike until Wednesday “Epektibo ang libreng sakay mula alas-6 ng umaga hanggang alas-9 ng gabi,” the DOTr said in an advisory.
